title: Prepayment Relief on Graduated-Return Lines of the Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit
content:
For a graduated-return line on a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan to which additional-principal payments, less any of them returned, totaling at least 500.00 USD posted in the twelve months before the line is scheduled takes 4 points off the share of the step up charged; one to which such payments, less any returned, totaling at least 100.00 USD but less than 500.00 USD posted takes 2 points off it; any other loan takes none, a payment counting as inside those twelve months when fewer than twelve whole calendar months separate its date from the day the line is scheduled. The payments are those of the additional-principal type on the loan's Personal Loans payment ledger.

| Additional principal in the twelve months, less returns | Points off the share |
|---|---|
| 500.00 USD or more | 4 |
| 100.00 USD to under 500.00 USD | 2 |
| under 100.00 USD | none |

*Hypothetical cases:* 600.00 USD posted with 100.00 USD returned is 500.00 USD net, 4 points; 600.00 USD posted with 150.00 USD returned is 450.00 USD, 2 points; 99.99 USD net takes none.
